name: jule
description: Build pop-ups, sign-up forms, quizzes, preference centers and landing pages as Jule projects through the Jule MCP server: the server connection and three skills.

interface.shortDescription: Pop-ups, forms, quizzes, preference centers and landing pages as Jule projects
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the Jule MCP server and teaches it how to author, preview, operate and analyze Jule projects — pop-ups, sign-up and newsletter forms, quizzes, preference centers and hosted landing pages — from a brief or a Figma design.
defaultPrompt: Build a newsletter sign-up pop-up with a 10% welcome coupon.
Turn this Figma frame into a landing page hosted by Jule.
How did the welcome pop-up do in the last 30 days, and what should we change?
